collab.title: A tech partner, not a competitor
collab.text: I’ve been working with agencies since 2016, after years as lead developer at web agencies abroad. I know all about tight deadlines, demanding clients and margins that need protecting.

items.title: Your brand, always
items.text: I work behind the scenes: the client only sees your agency. If you like, I join calls as part of your team.

items.title: No direct contact, ever
items.text: I never contact your clients or pitch to them. We put it in writing, in an NDA.

items.title: Your tools
items.text: ClickUp, Trello, Asana, GitHub, Google Meet: I slot into the way you work.

items.title: International experience
items.text: 15+ years, more than 400 projects, working in English, Italian, German and Spanish.

pricing.title: Your margin stays protected
pricing.text: Overrunning hours are what eat agency margins. That’s why every job has a **fixed quote**, with timeline and scope in writing. If the client changes their mind, we talk first and you decide: it never turns up later on the invoice.

points.text: **Projects**: a fixed price for every website, audit or integration.
**Maintenance**: a fixed monthly fee, no surprise bills.
**Changes**: scoped and approved by you before any work starts.

faq.title: Questions agencies ask
faq.text: Can’t see yours? [Drop me a line](#contatti) and I’ll reply by the next business day.

items.question: Do you really work under our brand?
items.answer: Yes. The end client only ever sees your agency: emails, documents and deliverables go out in your name. If you like, I join meetings as part of your team.

items.question: Will you sign an NDA?
items.answer: Of course, and I commit in writing never to contact or poach your clients.

items.question: How does the fixed price work?
items.answer: Every job gets a fixed quote with scope and timeline. Any changes the client asks for are scoped and approved by you before work starts.

items.question: What turnaround times can you guarantee?
items.answer: We agree them in the quote, based on complexity and my workload, and I stick to them. If a project is urgent, tell me straight away: I’ll give you an honest answer on whether it’s doable.

items.question: Do you work on websites built by others?
items.answer: Yes: speed, technical SEO, tracking, accessibility and maintenance can all be done on existing websites, after an initial review.

items.question: How do you invoice?
items.answer: I invoice your agency for the amount in the quote. You invoice the end client with your margin on top.
